name: Abony Acquisition Corp. I Units
summary: Abony Acquisition Corp. I (AACOU) functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), an entity specifically established with the sole aim of merging with, acquiring, or undertaking a similar strategic combination with one or more operational businesses. Each of its units typically includes one Class A ordinary share and a segment of a redeemable warrant, with comprehensive specifics available in the company's official public offering documents.
